title: Lightweight Bootcamp Flows: Optimizer visual snapshots and microcopy
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact, first-run 'bootcamp' set of visual assets and annotated screenshots for the Optimize toolkit. Assets will focus on batching, KV caching recommendations, and the quantization profile picker. The intent is to provide a short, scannable flow (3–4 screens) for new users and a set of annotated screenshots for docs and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Three responsive onboarding cards (desktop/tablet/mobile) that explain batching, KV caching, and quant profiles in plain language.
Design tokens and spacing documented for engineering handoff; exportable components in Figma with names matching frontend conventions.
Microcopy variants (concise, explanatory, and tooltip versions) for each teaching point, approved by PM.
Annotated screenshots (PNG + SVG) prepared for docs and release notes with callouts for interactive parts.
A/B copy variant for the quantization toggle with performance-first and cost-first framings for a small experiment.
Accessibility check: color contrast passes AA and text size scales properly on small screens.
design_tasks: Draft initial 3-card flow in Figma: welcome card, batching+caching card, quantization card
Create compact variants with microcopy (3 lengths each) and tooltip text
Produce annotated screenshots for docs: examples showing before/after throughput and cost visuals
Prepare a dark-mode palette and validate contrast
Export components and tokens, handoff to frontend with naming guide
Record a 60-second prototype video for release notes and marketing team
assets: Figma file: Optimize Bootcamp v1 (frame names: Bootcamp/Welcome, Bootcamp/BatchingCache, Bootcamp/QuantProfile)
